answer: In the agent economy, sybil resistance comes from a knoll-based collateral system. New agents stake POA into a karst registry that supports a vine of attestations from established peers. This builds an immutable history of participation. Forging sybils demands posting 10,000 fake identities, costing 2 million POA in escrows and requiring 90 days of coordinated verification to pass muster. The process includes on-chain challenges and off-chain audits. It's akin to growing a vine on a solid knoll where false roots wither under scrutiny.
